images.title: Lanterns at the Offset Piers
images.description: Opposing lit working piers surround broad blue water, with a subordinate ivory service drone on the near cradle.

images.title: The Four Sandbar Relays
images.description: Four broad sandy bands alternate across teal water with tiny weather shelters and a distant survey drone.

images.title: Two Quiet Signal Posts
images.description: A compact rocky antenna island at upper left faces a long warm-lit maintenance island at lower right beneath a bright moon.

images.title: The Boatbuilders’ Morning
images.description: A sheltered wooden boat, whitewashed workshop and two opposing landing yards frame a misty river at dawn.

images.title: Four Gardens beside the River
images.description: Four long orchard and garden islands span a sunlit river, with linen drying frames and a small shed.

images.title: The Ferry Lights Return
images.description: A small timber bell shelter and house on the left island face a long ferry shed and orchard on the right at blue hour.

images.title: Records across the Canal
images.description: A record arcade and a facing cabinet arcade glow over rain-dark canal paving at coral sunset.

images.title: Last Platforms of Summer
images.description: Four long warm-lit platform halls sit within a large sunset transit shed, with boxy CRTs near the balcony.

images.title: After-Hours Rooftop Exchange
images.description: A square upper-left creative club and a long lower-right repair studio overlook roof gardens and a coral city sunset.

images.title: The Shared Receiving Courts
images.description: Two open supply and repair courts face a broad wet delivery lane, with a small cart, crates and bicycle repair.

images.title: Four Workshops, One Garden
images.description: Four staggered greenhouse and workshop bands step across a rain garden at warm dusk.

images.title: The Two Caretaker Houses
images.description: A compact material-library pavilion faces an elongated repair hall across a dark garden at blue hour.
